source.name: Aider (legacy leaderboards)
source.description: Aider's older leaderboards: code editing (133 Python Exercism exercises) and refactoring (89 large Python methods).
notes: Code editing score = pass_rate_2 (solved within two attempts), the field the edit.html page shows as 'Percent completed correctly'.
Refactoring score = pass_rate_1, the field the refactor.html page shows.
Model names are aider's model strings as published (e.g. 'claude-3-opus-20240229'). total_cost_usd is the cost of the whole run.
Legacy boards: these benchmarks are no longer updated by aider.

benchmarks.name: Aider code editing
benchmarks.description: Percent of 133 small Python Exercism exercises solved and correctly edited by the model within two attempts.

benchmarks.name: Aider refactoring
benchmarks.description: Percent of 89 large Python methods the model refactored correctly (tests it lazy-coding / long outputs).
